AI Overview
Play the daily geography puzzle at Countryle. 
How to Play
Type a country: Enter a country name into the search bar at the bottom of the page. 
Countryle
Make your guess: Select the country from the list and click "Guess it!" 
Countryle
Read the clues: Use the feedback provided after each guess to narrow down the mystery nation:
Hemisphere & Continent: Check if you are in the right region or half of the globe.
Average Temperature: See if the target has a warmer or colder climate.
Population & Area: Look for directional arrows showing if the target is higher/lower or larger/smaller than your guess.
Coordinates: Find the relative cardinal direction (such as northwest or east) from your previous guess.
